SELECT sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (SELECT Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes
                                                             ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_%' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] LIKE 'otel-gateway-%' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))

SELECT (
SELECT sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (SELECT Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes
                                                             ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_refused_%' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] LIKE 'otel-gateway-%' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))) + (
SELECT sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (SELECT Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes
                                                             ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_exporter_send_failed_%' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] LIKE 'otel-gateway-%' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))) AS value

SELECT max(s.v / c.v) AS fill
FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, Attributes['data_type'] AS dt, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName = 'otelcol_exporter_queue_size' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE GROUP BY pod, dt) AS s
JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, Attributes['data_type'] AS dt, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName = 'otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE GROUP BY pod, dt) AS c
  ON s.pod = c.pod AND s.dt = c.dt

SELECT time, series, sum(if(delta < 0, Value, delta)) AS value
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, Value, concat('accepted ', replaceOne(MetricName, 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_', '')) AS series,
             Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER (PARTITION BY MetricName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix
                                                      ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS delta
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_%' AND bitAnd(Flags, 1) = 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] LIKE 'otel-gateway-%')
GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, value FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS time, 'stored spans' AS series, count() AS value
  FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND), 'stored log_records', count()
  FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY 1)
ORDER BY time
